SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' AND od.payment_yn = 'Y' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_price, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status = '99!' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancel_price, 0 AS discount_pice, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' AND od.payment_yn = 'Y' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status = '99!' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_price, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' THEN og.sys_id END) AS order_count FROM order_master om INNER JOIN order_group og ON og.link_sys_id = om.sys_id INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id INNER JOIN store_menu_detail smd ON smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT odo.link_sys_id, SUM(smod.menu_option_price * odo.qty) AS option_price FROM order_detail_option odo LEFT JOIN store_menu_option_detail smod ON smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 GROUP BY odo.link_sys_id ) opt_sum ON opt_sum.link_sys_id = od.sys_id WHERE 1=1 and om.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND DATE(om.insert_datetime) BETWEEN #{settlementRequest.searchStartDate} AND #{settlementRequest.searchEndDate}
AND om.payment_type = #{settlementRequest.paymentType}

SELECT DATE(om.insert_datetime) AS group_date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' AND od.payment_yn = 'Y' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS day_total_price, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status = '99!' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS day_cancel_price, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' AND od.payment_yn = 'Y' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN og.order_status = '99!' THEN smd.menu_price * od.qty + COALESCE(opt_sum.option_price, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS day_net_price, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN og.order_status != '99!' THEN og.sys_id END) AS day_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN og.order_status = '99!' THEN og.sys_id END) AS day_cancel_count FROM order_master om INNER JOIN order_group og ON og.link_sys_id = om.sys_id INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id INNER JOIN store_menu_detail smd ON smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT odo.link_sys_id, SUM(smod.menu_option_price * odo.qty) AS option_price FROM order_detail_option odo LEFT JOIN store_menu_option_detail smod ON smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 GROUP BY odo.link_sys_id ) opt_sum ON opt_sum.link_sys_id = od.sys_id WHERE 1=1 and om.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND DATE(om.insert_datetime) BETWEEN #{settlementRequest.searchStartDate} AND #{settlementRequest.searchEndDate} GROUP BY DATE(om.insert_datetime) ORDER BY DATE(om.insert_datetime)
